research_exceptions.note: Issuer-hosted Final Prospectus dated 2023-10-03; its URL is outside the existing builder allowlist. Source collected and reviewed, never disguised as a SEBI mirror; no whitelist expansion in this release. Its explicit Bid Lot 105 is a held observation, not authority for an allowlist bypass.
Annual report p65 states 11-Sep-2024 while p66 and audited note p107 state 11-Sep-2023. Original BSE admission notice 20230908-27 explicitly establishes 11-Sep-2023.
Third-party page used solely to find original BSE annual-report link; no third-party fields published.
Retained targeted SEBI search exposes RHP/DRHP but no final prospectus. Absence here is not a claim that no final mirror exists anywhere.

Historical listing statement p52 and repeated note p53 state October 12, 2023. A separate paragraph p72 prints October 12, 2013; retained as document inconsistency rather than rewriting the reviewed 2023 IPO timeline.
